portion_doctrine: Segments 31-40 of 122 are primarily Photoshop + Lightroom video tutorial transcriptions with heavy timecode/UI markup. Core operative content: clipping masks, clone stamp, liquify tool, Lightroom culling/organization workflows. Boilerplate dominates (intro/outro spiel, YouTube CTAs, repeated keyboard shortcuts). Real gold is isolated within the transcript flows and specific tool settings.
operating_rules: Clone Stamp: Create new layer (never background), sample via Alt/Option, use hardness reduction for blending, leverage show overlay in clone source for preview
Clone Stamp advanced: Use separate layers per complex job, merge via Shift+Click + Cmd/Ctrl E (or Layer menu), allows correction via move tool if placement is wrong
Liquify tool: Convert background to smart object first (non-destructive), forward warp tool is primary (90% usage), brush size/pressure are key controls
Liquify forward warp: Most powerful and commonly used liquify option, adjust via brush size ([ ] brackets), maintain background continuity to avoid liquify artifacts
Liquify brush reconstruct: Undo/paint-back tool, set all parameters to zero to reset, undo any local edits on demand

Lightroom culling workflow: Library view > grid view > flag/rate images via stars (5-star system), use compare tool (hold Cmd/Ctrl + click) to view two images side-by-side, cycle through multiples to identify favorites
Lightroom sync operations: Select multiple images (Cmd/Ctrl A), sync exposure/white balance across batch, export via File > Export
Photoshop transform: Cmd/Ctrl T for transform, Cmd/Ctrl J to duplicate layer, Cmd/Ctrl L for levels adjustment, Cmd/Ctrl I to invert mask, Cmd/Ctrl E to merge layers
Layer masking: Unlink layer/mask via chain link icon, allows independent movement, invert mask to flip visibility logic
Blend modes: Screen mode for light overlays, change via blend mode dropdown, layer visibility toggle for A/B comparison
Select subject: Cloud-based processing in Photoshop, automates selection of foreground subjects
Generative fill: Fill selected areas (selection brush + generative fill), solves common liquify artifacts/difficulties
tools: Lightroom library view (grid, loop, full screen modes)
